create_bluechip_bridge_bot: create a BlueChipBridgeBot instance wrapping an external bridge bot for OpenSpiel bridge games
convert_bid_to_action: convert a BlueChip bid string like '1H' to an OpenSpiel integer action id
convert_play_to_action: convert a BlueChip card play string like 'ck' to an OpenSpiel integer action id
convert_action_to_string: convert an OpenSpiel integer action id to a BlueChip action string like 'PASSES' or 'bids 1H'
run_bluechip_bridge_game: run a bridge game using BlueChipBridgeBot with a controller factory for external bot communication
